subject: row retrieval with datatables 1.10.2 and shiny latest build

messages.author: fde845d9a17e6a2f
messages.subject: row retrieval with datatables 1.10.2 and shiny latest build
parts:
Hi we are using rshiny in a research project.  I got the latest dev build installed and it's been working great.  However,  I do encounter a problem that I am hoping the Shiny team could help me fix.  In my R-Shiny script I render a datatable with 'drawCallback' function.  In this 'drawCallback' function, I would like to retrieve all the filtered rows (for further processing).  I followed the api examples from datatables, which work fine in standalone datatable examples.  But the same doesn't seem to work as expected when used in the context of shiny.  

Here's a simplified version of the problem.

output$mpgTable <- renderDataTable(
    mpgData,
   options=list(
           deferRender = FALSE,
           drawCallback= I( 'function( settings ) {
              console.log( "Data Tables has redrawn the table ");    
               var table = this.api();
               var tbdata = table.rows().data();
               console.log("num rows = "+tbdata.length);
             }')
     )

This is supposed to print the total number of rows (including the pages that aren't displayed) whenever the table is redrawn.  However, it only prints the number of rows in the first (current displayed) page.  
I verified that it works as expected outside shiny.  You can check working version here - http://live.datatables.net/bawidon/9/edit

Appreciate your help.
